description: Pinned Parboil subtractive-center 7-point operator with float c0=1/6 and c1=1/6/6 on an NxNxN grid with fixed input boundaries. One complete ping-pong sequence per process; emit accumulated raw kernel times.

non_scaling_params.name: num_timesteps
non_scaling_params.description: Number of dependent stencil kernel launches in the complete timed sequence

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
